title: Run-walk intervals

main.note: Starter: 1 min jog and 2 min walk repeated. Steady and Active: jog 3 min, walk 1 min. For 30 and 45 minutes, a 20 minute jog segment with 10 to 15 minutes of walking is allowed for Active users.

cues: Talk-test pace: you can speak in short sentences.
Land softly and keep shoulders relaxed.

title: Brisk walk
cues: Swing your arms naturally from your shoulders.
Step heel-to-toe with a comfortable stride.

title: Treadmill or elliptical easy
cues: Keep a light touch on the rails without leaning.
Look forward rather than down at your feet.

title: Free weights full body
cues: Exhale on the lift, inhale as you lower with control.
Pick a weight that feels comfortable on the final rep.

title: Bodyweight circuit
cues: Move smoothly and rest longer if your breathing gets heavy.
Keep your ribs stacked softly over your hips.

title: Resistance band workout
cues: Control the band on the way back instead of letting it snap.
Keep your neck long and shoulders down.

title: Stair session
cues: Place your whole foot on each step.
Use the handrail for light balance whenever needed.

title: Mobility flow

moves: Low lunge stretch 40 sec each side
Child's pose or seated fold 60 sec

cues: Breathe slowly through your nose and never force end range.
Ease out of any position that feels pinchy.

title: Balance and ankle strength
cues: Stand near a desk or wall for steady fingertip support.
Move slowly through your full comfortable range.

title: Core and back care

moves: Side plank on knees 20 sec each

cues: Keep your lower back neutral and quiet as your limbs move.
Breathe steadily instead of bracing hard.

title: Dance or fun cardio
cues: Move at your own rhythm and enjoy the music.
Take water breaks whenever you want.

title: Hike or outdoor day

main.note: Weekend plan: pick a nearby trail or park, take water, wear sturdy shoes, tell someone your route, and pace yourself on slopes. Includes a packing checklist.

cues: Shorten your stride on uphill sections.
Pause to enjoy the view and check in with your feet.
